name: agent-deck
style: Elegant LINE-ART illustration (outline style): the figure and every object are drawn with CLEAN, CLEARLY VISIBLE GOLD outlines on a deep navy background (#0e1024) — a confident medium-weight stroke, NEVER hairline-thin or wispy. Every single line must still read clearly when the picture is shrunk to a small card about 200px wide: no faint, barely-there strokes anywhere, and no line thinner than the main contour of the figure. Keep the stroke weight even across the whole picture. The shapes are NOT filled color blocks, NOT a chibi/mascot, NOT a solid silhouette. Refined and uncluttered, with calm space around the subject, but the main subject fills roughly the middle half of the frame — not a tiny figure lost in a large empty void. A gold ground ellipse under the figure, drawn as an UNFILLED OUTLINE only — the deep-navy background shows through it. Never fill the ellipse, and never fill any other shape. Exactly one element glows softly in the specified accent color; everything else stays gold line-art. Calm, dignified scenes with a gentle fantasy-journey flavor. The figure is shown from behind or in clean profile — never a forward-facing face, keep the face plain/featureless. Human anatomy: exactly two arms and two legs, clearly separated, no extra or missing limbs, a simple standing or seated posture. GENERIC only: no specific religious symbols or sect emblems, no recognizable people, brands, franchises, or logos. STRICT: no text, no letters, no numbers, no real glyphs, no speech bubbles, no sun or large glowing disc, a single calm scene, no collage, no split panels.

items.prompt: A gatekeeper of a threshold: a figure from behind standing before a tall closed gate, raising a lantern to inspect the doorframe; a ring of keys hangs at the waist. Accent glow: emerald green light of the lantern.

A first-time visitor arriving alone: a small lone figure from behind standing outside a half-open doorway of a warmly lit hall, one hand hesitating near the frame, a small travel bag on the ground at the feet. Accent glow: emerald green light spilling out from the doorway.

A newcomer who has stopped on the way: a figure from behind halted on a path before a wooden signpost whose boards are completely blank and empty with nothing written on them, head tilted; the path forks beyond. Accent glow: emerald green light on one empty board.

A master artisan inspecting a staircase: an elder figure seen in STRICT SIDE PROFILE with the face turned fully away from the viewer and left plain and featureless, standing beside a wooden staircase and holding a long straight measuring rod down onto one step to check it; one step is clearly uneven. The whole picture sits on the flat deep-navy background — no circular vignette, no pale or white backdrop. Accent glow: emerald green light on the uneven step.

A scout testing a newly built bridge: a figure from behind tapping the planks of a new bridge with a long staff, thin gold ripples of sound spreading from the point of contact. The ground ellipse under the scene is an UNFILLED outline only — the deep-navy background shows through it. Accent glow: terracotta orange light where the staff meets the plank.

A keeper of the house voice: a figure from behind holding up a completely blank unrolled scroll with nothing written on it toward a hanging wind chime, listening. Accent glow: rose pink light of the wind chime.

A keeper of instruments: a figure from behind facing a wall of round unmarked dials with plain needles and no markings on their faces, reaching toward one of them. Accent glow: warm mustard amber light behind the single dial being read.

A reader of many answers: a figure seen strictly from behind with the back turned to the viewer, standing at the railing of an observatory balcony, head tilted up toward many small floating points of light arranged in a loose constellation in the night sky; one blank empty board is held low at the side in one hand. Accent glow: cool blue light of the constellation.
